findings: e34 alone: subgrid_orographic 1.0 S 0.9978 (rain -0.55 %), 2.5 S 0.9970 (rain -0.83 %); hilly regions improve 4-5 % (Anatolia, Alps, New Zealand, Japan) but e34 adds rain overall and the regions already too wet (east Australia +8.6 % rain loss, western Europe, Manchuria, the Cape) fail the training group. eddy_heat 0.5: S 1.0153, maritime regions much worse; rejected.
